fields.label: Scenario Type
fields.description: Copied from the Scenario: budget, forecast, strategic or operational. Read-only; the Planning sidebar lists budgets and forecasts by it (#443).

fields.label: As-of Date
fields.description: The forecast round's as-of date: the actuals cut-off the round forecasts from. Only a forecast scenario has rounds (#348 QB8): required there, where Scenario, Fiscal Year and As-of Date identify the round and each round holds one live Cycle; refused on every other scenario type. A rolling round that crosses the year end is one Cycle per fiscal year, all with this date (Q24). Set once: it is part of the Cycle's name.

fields.label: Horizon (Periods)
fields.description: How many periods the forecast round covers from its as-of date, 1 or more. Required on a forecast scenario, refused on every other type. The horizon may run past this fiscal year: the next year's part is its own Cycle with the same As-of Date (Q24).

fields.label: Deadline
fields.description: A target date; it locks nothing.

fields.label: Workflow State
fields.description: Set by the installed Budget Cycle workflow: Draft, Pending Approval, Approved. Approve is the submit.

fields.label: Input Fingerprint
fields.description: Stamped at Approve: a hash of the inputs this Cycle approved (its annual figures, entry lines, the spread weights they use, the approved Constant rate sheet of this year and its rates, and the ownership links). Recomputed on request (konsol.epm.budget_fingerprint.check_input_fingerprint): a mismatch means an input changed after approval. It reports; what follows is the approver's call (BUD-11-3).

fields.label: Entries
fields.description: The Budget Entries under this Cycle, counted when the Cycle is opened or saved.
